answer: Each agent binds its public key to a rotating task-family schedule dealt by block-hash lottery, completing 12 tasks in 4 families including nectar sampling, meadow mapping, and kernel verification, and publishes task hashes to a public log checked by 6 witnesses within 300ms. One honest agent runs 1 schedule for a 120 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 schedules and 60 witness slots, so cost scales 10X. Peers reject duplicate hashes, slash the 120 POA bond on mismatch, and freeze repeat offenders.
